ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in the Cartesian coordinate system, the rectangle $OABC$ has its vertex $O$ at the origin. Side $OC$ is on the positive half of the $x$-axis, and side $OA$ is on the positive half of the $y$-axis, with $OA=3$ and $AB=4$. The graph of the inverse proportion function $y=\frac{k}{x}$ ($k>0$) intersects sides $AB$ and $BC$ at points $D$ and $E$, respectively, and $BD=2AD$. Find the coordinates of point $D$ and the value of $k$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $AB=4$ and $BD=2AD$,\\
it follows that $AB=AD+BD=AD+2AD=3AD=4$,\\
hence $AD=\frac{4}{3}$.\\
Also, given that $OA=3$,\\
it follows that $D\left(\frac{4}{3}, 3\right)$.\\
Since point D lies on the hyperbola $y=\frac{k}{x}$,\\
it follows that $k=\frac{4}{3}\times 3=\boxed{4}$.
